summary: Iteration 7 - Stripe Payments + Analytics + AI Operations Advisor + Daily Scheduler. Backend: 67/67 pytest tests PASS (added 9 new tests for payments transactions list, unpaid-checkout polling, rev-saas auto-creation, posting-times, platform-mix, viral-themes, advisor recommend with Claude Sonnet, advisor recent). Frontend verified live on https://gmaos-control.preview.emergentagent.com: /analytics renders AI Operations Advisor card (Get Recommendation click successfully calls Claude Sonnet 4-5 via Emergent LLM and returns structured headline+next_action+rationale with high confidence, $0 cost), plus Revenue Momentum, Conversion Funnel, Best Posting Times, Stream ROI table, Platform Mix, Viral Themes; /pricing renders 3 PriceCards ($49 Starter one-time, $99 Pro/month, $499 Enterprise/month) - clicking Subscribe/Buy on Starter fires POST /api/payments/checkout and returns a real cs_test_ Stripe session URL (navigation blocked by test route to avoid completing payment); /payment-success polls /api/payments/checkout/{sid} with attempt counter ('Polling status (attempt 2/10)') for unknown sessions. Sidebar now includes 'Analytics' (Operations) and 'Pricing & Pay In' (Revenue). Scheduler verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'auto-cycle scheduler started (daily at 07:00 UTC)' and 'auto-cycle sleeping 18010s until 7UTC'. Dashboard shows $0 everywhere on fresh DB as required by user (no synthetic data).

minor.issue: Returns 500 when session_id does not exist on Stripe (e.g., manually-crafted fake id). The Stripe SDK raises an exception that isn't caught - should return 404 instead. In normal user flow this never happens (Stripe redirects always carry a real session_id), and the dedicated unpaid-real-session test passes 200. PaymentSuccess UI polls 10 times getting 500s in the bogus case but still shows a graceful 'Processing payment...' state. Suggested fix: wrap stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status in try/except and raise HTTPException(404).

issues: Multiple console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - some ResponsiveContainer wrappers are mounting before parent has measurable size (likely the Momentum chart card when its data is empty / has 0 trend points). Non-blocking, chart still renders. Fix: give chart parent an explicit minHeight or render-guard the chart when trend_by_day is empty.
UI keeps polling 10 times when backend returns 500, never surfacing the error to the user. Should detect non-2xx response and switch to an error state with a 'Return to pricing' CTA.

action_items: (Minor, polish) Wrap stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status in try/except in routes/payments.py to return 404 instead of 500 for unknown session_id.
(Minor, polish) PaymentSuccess.js should stop polling and show an error state if /api/payments/checkout/{sid} returns >=400.
(Minor, design) Suppress Recharts width(-1) warnings on /analytics by guarding chart render when trend_by_day is empty (or setting an explicit minHeight on the chart container).
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: Server-side fixed PACKAGES dict prevents amount tampering from frontend - correct security pattern.
payments.py: _record_paid_to_ledger is idempotent (checks ledger_entry_id before writing) and properly logs an audit event - good.
payments.py: _ensure_saas_stream creates rev-saas idempotently on every checkout - clean bootstrap so the $25K meter has a target stream waiting for paid checkouts.

advisor.py: Falls back to confidence='low' with raw text if Claude returns unstructured output (does NOT 500 the user) - matches the spec; verified with live call returning fully-structured JSON with rationale citing actual ledger data.
analytics.py: All 6 endpoints safe-default on empty data (verified momentum returns cumulative_net=0 + remaining_to_25k=25000 on cleared ledger).
scheduler_service.py: Disabled when SYSTEM_MODE=test and current SYSTEM_MODE=production - scheduler is correctly running.
Webhook endpoint /api/payments/webhook is registered and idempotent; not exercised by tests (no Stripe signature available in CI) but code path is reviewed and correct.
Cost Guard: STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent (Emergent-supplied test mode); EMERGENT_LLM_KEY drives Claude Sonnet at $0 to operator. Both honored, no paid API used.
